{{apichanges|1.13.2|next=1.13.3}} Classic 1.13.2 is based on [[World_of_Warcraft_API#8.x_API|Patch 8.1.0]] and reintroduced Vanilla API. The BlizzCon 2018 [https://worldofwarcraft.com/en-us/news/22551243/bring-home-the-blizzcon-wow-classic-demo-with-the-virtual-ticket playable demo] (1.13.0) was based on 7.3.5 API. See also: * Reddit: [https://www.reddit.com/r/classicwow/comments/bnn2jp/diff_of_current_classic_vs_live_part_2_framexml/ Diff of current Classic vs Live. - Part 2. FrameXML] * BlizzardInterfaceResources: [https://github.com/Ketho/BlizzardInterfaceResources/commit/dfe14662c6aeef9a968daf1609b8b8327e610622 1.13.2 (30406)] * How to: [[Porting addons to Classic]] ==[[FrameXML]] diffs== : Live 7.3.5 (26972) to [https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/commit/14a0a0f8d375beeff8e87d5968f66f3b68ffef35 Classic 1.13 (28211)], [https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/commit/2d7f423760a3ff3a17defcee958a590cf499a05b 1.13.2 (30406)], (undocumented: [https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/commit/b8c01bc00d96dcbea6c8e7971a2432d278d41c08 30550], [https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/commit/60ad65ce76e320f24d9106b8c165fc8c0593b0cc 30682], [https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/commit/c0a8c6db57d178c50758151021968efe1601f345 30786], [https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/commit/73f4026aeefc10bca0bffa32a7faed9888d86709 31043], [https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/commit/fa1c48a6afcfc3e6826d8ea849d3e947a43b6dc4 31209], [https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/commit/8ef82f4df74201fcdde4ad748bfa50046a864ac3 31402], [https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/commit/e277bfeab30695403c446f1a2611cc3eb9bb509f 31446], [https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/commit/79b5609144c188bc7a643a11e54ec3613e436edb 31650]) ==Changes== * The [[Getting_the_current_interface_number|TOC version]] is 11302 * The ''focus'' [[UnitId]] was removed. * Quest and Spell [[UI_escape_sequences#Hyperlinks|hyperlinks]] can't be linked to chat channels and show up as plain text. Even when pasting them manually the server won't allow them to be posted. * The [[COMBAT_LOG_EVENT|Combat Log]] is restricted to events within 50 yards of the player. (Build 32600, Nov 20 2019) {{ref web|url=https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/in-game-combat-log-range-decreased/370390|author=Kaivax|date=2019-11-22|title=In-Game Combat Log Range Decreased}} ===API=== * Re-added the Crafting UI which is used for [[Enchanting]] and [[:Beast Training]]. * Any deprecated API was removed along with the [https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/tree/live/AddOns/Blizzard_Deprecated Blizzard_Deprecated] addon, most notably the old aliases to [[World_of_Warcraft_API#Friends|C_FriendList]] functions. * {{api|C_FriendList.SendWho}}() requires a hardware event as a measure against gold spam channel invites and other unintended uses for automatically querying player names. ===Cast Bars=== * {{api|UnitCastingInfo}}() was downgraded to {{api|CastingInfo}}() which is essentially UnitCastingInfo("player") * Idem for {{api|UnitChannelInfo}}() and {{api|ChannelInfo}}() ===CVars=== * CVar {{api|t=e|nameplateMaxDistance}} is effectively locked to 20 yards after the unlimited distance with scientific notation bug. * CVar {{api|t=c|chatClassColorOverride}} defaults to 1 (never color by class name) instead of 0 (always color by class name). * The default UI scale on classic is 0.9 up from 0.64 in retail, see CVar {{api|t=c|minimumAutomaticUiScale}}. ===Spells=== * The Combat Log no longer has access to Spell IDs, they are always returned as 0, since they were only added to the combat log in patch 2.4 * [[UNIT_SPELLCAST_SUCCEEDED|UNIT_SPELLCAST_*]] events only fire for the player. ==Global API== See also: [[World of Warcraft API#Classic Specific Functions]] {| class="wikitable" style="min-width: 600px" |+ Global API 8.1.5 (29981) → 1.13.2 (30406) |- class="mw-customtoggle-global-c" style="cursor: pointer" ! style="width: 50%; padding-right: 1em;"| 121 new functions ! style="width: 50%; padding-right: 1em;"| 2008 removed functions |- class="mw-collapsible" id="mw-customcollapsible-global-c" | valign="top" |
